title: 957. Flip Binary Tree To Match Preorder Traversal

examples.explanation: Flipping never changes the root value, so a voyage starting with 2 cannot be produced from a tree rooted at 1.
Swapping the two children of node 1 makes the preorder visit 1, then 3, then 2.
The tree already visits nodes in the requested order, so nothing is flipped.
